# Compare runs

Pick two runs and a metric. The classification uses the same procedure as the
command line: a two-sided Mann-Whitney U test with a minimum effect, so a
percentage is only labelled when it is both significant and large enough to matter.

The selection is part of the URL, so a comparison can be linked or bookmarked.
